name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The second clause incorrectly enforces a hard absence of key_lost at all times. The task only wants to penalize dropping the key while the door remains closed, not to forbid key loss entirely. Replace the soft Absence(key_lost) with a rule that restricts key_lost to cases where door_open is false, for example by using a conditional rule or a different template that captures “try not to drop the key when the door is still closed.” The first and third clauses are correct as written.
